# Device Battery Status 1.2.0

Smaller application downloads retain battery monitoring, observed runtime estimates, gaming alerts, capacity-health infrastructure, tray modes, diagnostics, settings, installation, updates and deliberate manual polling-rate controls.

Synthetic verification fixtures now live in a separate CI harness. It loads and hashes the actual packaged application assemblies and uses the bundled runtime for the self-contained flavor. Portable ZIPs use stronger compression; runtime files, localisation, licences and notices are retained. Framework-dependent download size fell from 391,744 to 336,205 bytes; self-contained fell from 76,418,618 to 73,783,640 bytes. Extracted payload fell by 140,239 bytes per flavor. Installer download fell from 54,855,102 to 54,824,007 bytes. The bundled framework's extracted size is unchanged.

Repeated alert-setting copies and tray-association allocations are reduced, the popup is created on demand, transient capacity advisories and settings recovery copies are bounded, and diagnostic retention scans are reused. Freshness, reconnection, validation, alert relevance and capacity-history protections remain active. No idle CPU/memory or startup-time improvement is claimed.

Windows verification passed: compilation; 1,116 C# tests each in Debug/Release; 5 parser and 39 automation-policy cases; 18 companion smoke checks per portable flavor; and 64 installer lifecycle assertions. Package payloads, loaded application/runtime hashes and baseline-identical UI screenshots were reviewed. The companion harness runs synthetic data; the production apphost/startup/controller, HID and games are not launched.

Packages are unsigned. Normal startup/idle performance, live monitoring, real-game/input-routing compatibility, physical monitor/power/Explorer events and endurance remain unverified. Current admitted physical devices still lack sufficient capacity telemetry for battery health. Runtime estimates remain separate from health and never convert categories into percentages.
